description: Ticked fourteen lines and broke a pen.
name: Abel Garnish

description: Answered for Raye. Five shillings held, ten ahead, both sides.
name: William Blackwage, Ralph Raye, Richard Hoope

description: Ended the half-wages in speech, and said Raye may bank on both sides.
name: John Heminges

description: Counted fifty-two shillings, and not one lawyer.
name: Goodwife Margery Pell

description: Gave the reason, and enjoyed it.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Spent the stored month as Costard, and stayed on you.
name: Will Kemp

description: Named the gear, the count and the letter, and stopped.
name: William Shakespeare
